column1: I got a new capital one credit card. I go to log in to the app and it wants to send a code to my phone. I never get a code. I clicked the call me option. No phone call. I dig and see an option to upload my ID. I click it and nothing happens. I call them and they say it's because they can't verify my identity through my phone number. They were happy to ding my credit, open the account, send and activate the card, but when I try to manage the account that's when security kicks in. I cancelled it.

Once I pay off my auto loan, I won't be able to uninstall fast enough!

I was pleasantly surprised when I was Approved for this card! and a Capitol One card at that. I've been slowly fixing my credit forever now, it isn't easy, especially on a limited budget. I got turned down time and time again, and that was just at the Pre-qualification point! I sincerely thank C.O. for giving me the chance to start building healthy credit again. I had a series of unfortunate events, beyond my control. Now I can work on getting back to where I use to be! This is so exciting!

Why is there not an option to auto apply cashback to my balance? There is a whole 7 extra steps now I never needed before. Baffling.

I try to pay off my small one, my wife has a small one, my large one time is the key with that one. but I have paid it off in the past if you look. it takes time, we don't get snap, this is the way we do it, with the card. this one is for my dog and I didn't realize that it was so much this time. I'm working on getting it paid. I don't want to lose this card.

I'm American, but I travel to Vietnam frequently, so I default my phone to Vietnamese, which, like many languages, swaps the decimal point and comma, unlike in the US. This makes the Capital One app go haywire. It forces me to use Viet notation, but then it doesn't seem to understand that notation! For example, it forces me to input $1000 as $1000,00 but then tells me there's an error in the amount and won't let me proceed!

Then there's ph #s on the acct that are NOT mine! & no one can help me til 8am, if I would have known I was going to have to go thru all this I NEVER would have applied for their card! pffft waste of my time!! I hate this app & bank! I'm never using this card!
